svg.title: BM25: rare terms carry the score
svg.desc: A hand-drawn whiteboard showing an inverted index whose common term 'return' has a posting list running off the page while 'ORA-01555' has exactly two postings, the BM25 formula written large with IDF underlined blue, the term-frequency numerator green and the saturating denominator amber, each labelled by hand. A saturation curve rises from 1.00 at one occurrence to only 2.17 at a hundred against a dashed ceiling of 2.2, four bars show one rare identifier with IDF 7.74 dwarfing 'error' and 'code' with the stopword struck out, and two result lists show dense retrieval putting the answer at rank 14 while BM25 puts it first, 0.39 against 0.94.
